# Pull Request

## Purpose and Scope

Describe the bounded change and the user decision it supports.

## Canonical Sources

List changed source-of-truth files and explain why derived artifacts changed.

## Validation

- [ ] Unit tests pass.
- [ ] Repository validation passes.
- [ ] Internal links and anchors pass.
- [ ] Generated reports are current.
- [ ] No secrets or personal data are included.
- [ ] Changelog is updated when required.

## Risk and Recovery

State risks, reversibility, migration impact, and rollback or correction steps.

## Architecture

- [ ] No architecture change is present.
- [ ] An approved ADR is linked if architecture changes.
